comment: EapSimAkaIdentityTracker will manage information to support Re-authentication & Pseudonym.

variables.name: sReauthInfoMap
variables.comment:
* The LinkedHashMap to preserve credentials for re-authentication, with concatenation of reauth * ID and permanent ID as the key and ReauthInfo as the value. * *

A map entry will be deleted either if the map size reaches the max quota and the * entry is the oldest, or if the ReauthInfo of this entry is found expired when a new * ReauthInfo is registered
